topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't believe I've hit this wall. After months of pouring every spare moment into developing what I thought was an innovative solution, I find out it's already patented. I've been so focused, diving deep into the mechanics, testing, and refining, that I didn't even consider this possibility. Now, here I am, staring at a patent document with someone else's name on it. It feels like all the air has been sucked out of my project. I need to figure out what to do next, but right now, my mind is spinning, and all my dreams for this invention are hanging by a thread.
